prompt:
A detailed 3D paper quilling relief artwork of an elegant woman in a stylish off-the-shoulder corset dress made of intricate white paper flowers.

She wears a large, wide-brimmed coiled ivory paper hat adorned with small vibrant green leaves and coral-pink paper blooms, with the underside of the hat lined with rich green leaf textures. Her flowing, wavy silver-white hair cascades down her shoulders in delicate quilled paper strands.

The figure stands in a three-quarter side profile holding a slender green flower stem. Flanking her waist and hips are large, layered fan-like green quilled leaves accented with curving white paper ribbons.

The entire piece is set against a smooth, clean light gray studio background with realistic soft drop shadows under each paper layer to create depth

--ar 1:1
